responsibility: Provides the procedural macro support that lets the compiler’s type-IR data structures automatically implement core traversal and conversion traits. In its root file, the crate defines and registers the derive macros for `TypeVisitable`, `TypeFoldable`, and `Lift`, generating the corresponding impls for structs and enums, honoring helper attributes such as `#[type_visitable(ignore)]` and `#[type_foldable(identity)]`, introducing the required interner-related generics and bounds, and rewriting lifted types from interner `I` to `J` for `Lift`. Through these derives, the crate contributes reusable code generation for rustc’s type system infrastructure so other compiler crates can declare type-IR nodes and obtain the standard visiting, folding, and interner-lifting behavior consistently.
